actual_source_trace: src/urllib3/util/retry.py:199-215 new() omits respect_retry_after_header while __init__ defaults it to True; increment() returns self.new(...).
Retry.is_retry returns True for allowed methods and explicit status_forcelist membership before consulting the automatic header-retry policy.
HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen response-status branch calls retries.increment then retries.sleep(response). The newly constructed Retry now defaults the opt-out back to True.

Independently, pre-fix Retry.sleep(response) enters sleep_for_retry for any truthy response without checking respect_retry_after_header. A positive header triggers time.sleep even for a directly configured False instance.

contracts.contract: Retry attempts create new Retry objects with updated values; respect_retry_after_header controls respecting Retry-After on RETRY_AFTER_STATUS_CODES; independent status_forcelist can force response-status retries.
The status-retry production branch calls is_retry, increment, then sleep(response) before recursively requesting again.
Public callers configure Retry instances at pool level and per request.

expected: Opt-out remains False in subsequent Retry state; retry timing uses configured backoff instead of the positive Retry-After value.
